noninteractive_fallbacks.backend: Keep stopped: configured entrypoint runs db:prepare catalog:sync. Do not start or mutate database. Use host stdlib tools/packaged native AST; record Ruby suite unavailable until safe existing runtime is available.
noninteractive_fallbacks.ollama: Existing serve-only container may start; no model downloads or original-store changes.
noninteractive_fallbacks.training: No optimizer unless all nine gates met; use approved deployed model for inference only.
noninteractive_fallbacks.remote: No uploads, publication, paid external calls or external repository writes.
noninteractive_fallbacks.scope: No unrelated reader UI, schema, infra, MCP ecosystem or VivaBem access.

checkpoints: At approximately30min and critical changes, exact working hashes plus append-only queue; never include giant prior cuts recursively
approval: Technical recommendation never owner publication/training/commit approval
